summary: AgentBadge is a public on-chain identity system for AI agents. The following policy specifies how LLM providers and search crawlers may use content from this site.

training.notes: Content is not licensed for pre-training or fine-tuning of foundation models without explicit written permission. See LICENSE in the GitHub repository for code licensing terms.

retrievalAugmentedGeneration.notes: Crawling for retrieval-augmented generation and search indexing is explicitly allowed. AgentBadge publishes /llms.txt and /ai-sitemap.xml to make RAG-friendly content discoverable.

summarizationAndQuotation.notes: LLMs may summarize and quote from public AgentBadge pages when attributing the source URL. Each /about, /pricing, /agent-guide, /use-cases, /faq page contains canonical URLs in JSON-LD for this purpose.

agenticActions.notes: LLM agents may interact with the AgentBadge API and MCP server. Paid actions (passport mint) require x402 payment. All endpoints are documented at /api/specs (OpenAPI 3.1) and /llms.txt.

rateLimits.notes: Rate limits are enforced by the server. Agents exceeding limits receive 429 with Retry-After header.

preferredContentFormat: JSON-LD schema.org + Markdown sections + plain text in /llms.txt

ipAndAttribution.licenseContent: All rights reserved — text and visuals. Code is MIT.
